item.title: vscode: Tune GitHub Copilot Inline Suggestions with Configurable Eagerness
item.description:
The article announces a new setting to control how proactively GitHub Copilot shows inline suggestions in VS Code. It lets users tune suggestion eagerness rather than using a fixed behavior.

  • Source: VS Code Updates and Blog
